title: Busse balloon deformation and splitting by non-local interaction: the influence of grazing on a Klausmeier vegetation model
summary: Large areas on all continents except Antarctica are covered by dryland vegetation patterns, with wavelengths typically in the range of tens of meters. In models, many wavelengths are simultaneously stable, and we argue that this multi-stability also holds for real world patterns. We then study the shape of the Busse balloon representation of multi-stability for a previously introduced Klausmeier model with non-local grazing.
